subject: Social Media
title: Decentralized Social Media
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Decentralized Social Media.

hook.text: Mastodon has no algorithm. Every post appears in time order. It feels like 2008 internet.

buildup.text: Bluesky, Mastodon, and Nostr let users choose their algorithm—or use none. It's the fediverse.

discovery.text: No central company controls these networks. Servers run independently. Nobody owns the whole.

twist.text: Freedom brought chaos. Without algorithms, spam and abuse flooded smaller servers unchecked.

climax.text: Bluesky tried user-selected algorithms as plug-ins. You choose your own filter, not a company.

punchline.text: Freedom without structure is just noise.

quiz.question: What is the 'fediverse'?
options: A network of decentralized social platforms
